notes: A task opens in a window over the board

entries.title: A task opens in a window over the board
entries.detail: Editing or creating a task now opens a window on top of the board, and the board, the filters and your place on the page stay as they are. Close it with its x, with a click beside it or with Escape. Undo and Redo are in the window, the fields have their normal size, and subtasks and comments read as a list of rows. On a phone the window fills the screen.

entries.title: Filter by epic · Blocked by moves under Epic
entries.detail: Filter by epic: A fifth filter button, Epic, sits after Size. Tick an epic to see it with its tasks, or No epic for the tasks in none; each choice shows how many tasks it gives, and the tabula logo clears it with the other filters. Its Sort groups the tasks by their epic's number. Under the filters, the buttons now read Select, Review, For you. Blocked by moves under Epic: In a task's editor, Blocked by now sits below the Epic section, just above Comments.

entries.title: The bulk bar follows the filter buttons
entries.detail: When you change many tasks at once, the bar at the foot now lists Tag, Status, Priority and Size in the order of the filter buttons above, then Epic. The first filter button reads Tag: All, singular like the others.

entries.title: Find the epic by typing
entries.detail: Part of and Blocked by no longer list every open task. Type a few letters of the title, or the task's number (12 finds T-012), and the matches appear below, best first, with the letters you typed in bold. Pick one with a click, or with the arrow keys and Enter. Escape empties the search and leaves the task open. The Epic section now sits just above Comments.

entries.title: Change many tasks at once and 2 more
entries.detail: Change many tasks at once: Press Select under the filters, then select tasks with their checkbox, by pressing a card's title, or with All shown. The bar at the foot sets Status, Tag, Priority, Size or Epic on all of them, and one Undo takes it back. A task that cannot take the change, such as one with open subtasks set to Done, is left as it was and named in the message. A task can wait for others: In a task's editor, Blocked by names the tasks it waits for. It offers none that would wait in a circle, and lists the tasks waiting for this one. While one of them is still open, the card shows an hourglass and that task's number: press it to open that task. When the last one is done, the people on a shared waiting task hear of it in For you. Epics: tasks that hold tasks: A task can hold other tasks now. In a task's editor, Part of puts it into another task, and an epic's editor lists its tasks and adds new ones. A card names the epic it is part of, or counts how many of its tasks are done. On the board, Swimlanes › Epic gives each epic a row: drop a card in a row to move it there. One level only: a task in an epic holds no tasks of its own.

entries.title: Type together in subtasks
entries.detail: In a shared task, a subtask's text now changes letter by letter too, with the other person's named cursor, as the title and description do.

entries.title: A tidier Share window
entries.detail: People to add are rows now, the same as the people on the task, each with an Add button. A person's role stands beside their address.

entries.title: People are rounded squares
entries.detail: A person's mark is a rounded square now, with no box around it and with letters that fit. On a card the marks stand side by side, not on top of each other.

entries.title: Tidier Backups and Users
entries.detail: On a phone, a backup's date stays whole and its buttons stand under it. In Users, a person's face no longer sits in a box. Settings › Data no longer names a setting that is gone.

entries.title: A new task is kept until it saves
entries.detail: Since sharing arrived, the database could refuse a task made in the app, and the task was gone at the next reload. That is fixed. If a new task cannot be saved, for any reason, tabula now keeps it and sends it again when you next open the app.

entries.title: About tabula fits the Settings window
entries.detail: The facts of this version stand in two columns. Before, the bottom of About tabula was cut off until you scrolled, and the wheel moved every part a little.

entries.title: Brain knows when a task repeats
entries.detail: Asked about one task, Brain said it does not repeat, even when it does. Brain now reads the repeat and how it ends.

entries.title: Share by pressing a face
entries.detail: The Share window shows everyone on the Users list as a face. Press one to share the task. There is no address to type any more, and new people join in Settings › Users.

entries.title: Share with one press
entries.detail: The Share window shows the people you already share with as faces. Press one to share the task, with no address to type.

entries.title: Live typing in shared tasks
entries.detail: In a shared task, title and description now change letter by letter, with named cursors, and the task says who else is there. Private tasks stay as they are.

entries.title: Automatic updates left Settings
entries.detail: Settings › Mac app no longer has the Automatic updates switch. tabula › Check for Updates… stays in the menu.

entries.title: Work on a task with other people
entries.detail: Open a task and press the person icon to share it. A shared task shows faces on its card. Say who does it, write comments with @names, and see what others did under For you. Your star, tags and archive stay your own. This replaces handing over a copy.

entries.title: No scrollbar in Settings
entries.detail: The Settings window shows no scrollbar. On a short screen a long part still scrolls with the wheel, the trackpad or a finger.

entries.title: Settings has folia's height
entries.detail: The Settings window is now as tall as folia's: 925px, less on a shorter screen. A part taller than that scrolls.

entries.title: About tabula says where your tasks live
entries.detail: Settings › About tabula has a new part, Where your tasks live. This version now also shows when tabula started and the build of the web app. The Armarium part and its task count are gone.

entries.title: Two dots under the task number
entries.detail: The yellow dot is gone: a card now shows the green start dot and the red due dot. The space between the task number, the dots and the subtask count is even. A due date in the next 3 days still shows in orange on the Due value.

entries.title: Task numbers without a line
entries.detail: The task number on a card, such as T-123, no longer has a line under it. You still click it to open the card.

entries.title: A new name in About tabula
entries.detail: In Settings › About tabula, the group with Started and Tasks is now called Armarium.

entries.title: The old address now leads to tabula
entries.detail: j4k.pixelina.me sends you to tabula.pixelina.me, and links keep their task or view. The j4k Mac app stops working with this page: install the tabula Mac app from Settings › Mac app in your browser.

entries.title: j4k is now tabula
entries.detail: A new name, tabula: Latin for a board or a writing tablet. The address is tabula.pixelina.me, and the old one still works for now. Your tasks and settings came along, and they are now stored in Zurich. The Mac app is a new app: install it once and sign in once. It takes your hotkey and your Mac settings from j4k. Old backups still import. On a phone under 390 pixels wide, the Minimum/Maximum button is in Settings › General only.

entries.title: Swimlanes by Week Start and by Week Due
entries.detail: On the Kanban board, Swimlanes has two week groupings now. Week Start makes one row per week that holds a start date, Week Due one row per week that holds a due date. A card dropped on a Week Due row keeps its weekday in that week, or gets the Friday when it has no due date yet.

entries.title: The Priority selector is easy to read again
entries.detail: In dark mode, High, Medium and Low in the task editor had pale grey text on a pale fill. The word is dark again, as it should be.

entries.title: Other apps can open j4k on a view
entries.detail: A link j4k://show with the filters of a view brings the j4k Mac app to the front on that view. GLaDOS uses it to show you your tasks in j4k, not in a browser tab.

entries.title: About and What's New in the family's style
entries.detail: About and What's New in the Mac app follow the folia style guide now, as Settings does: a head, a body of soft cards, and a foot with the buttons on the right. Done is the one amber button.

entries.title: Deleted tasks are kept 30 days, with no setting
entries.detail: Settings › Data no longer has Keep deleted tasks. A deleted task can always be restored for 30 days, on every device, and is then removed for good.

entries.title: Dark task cards have no bright white any more
entries.detail: In dark mode, a task's title, the count of done subtasks, the subtasks, the comments, the headings and the icons are now the same soft grey as folia's text, on the card and while you edit it. A link in a description is gold again in dark mode; it was a dark brown that was hard to read.

entries.title: A task's description reads in folia's softer text colour
entries.detail: The text of a description is now the same soft grey as a page in folia, in light and dark mode. In dark mode it was nearly white before, which was harder on the eyes.

entries.title: j4k follows the folia style guide
entries.detail: Text uses your system font at folia's sizes, and gold text and focus lines use folia's slightly darker gold, which is easier to read. In Settings and the other windows, the buttons, selects and fields in a row are 30 pixels high with smaller text, and the buttons at the foot of a window are 34 pixels high, as in folia.

entries.title: Mail no longer freezes while j4k looks for flagged mails
entries.detail: Mail integration now reads flagged mails from the inbox of each account only, and asks Mail far fewer questions. Searching every folder could keep Mail busy for hours on a large mailbox. A mail you flag in another folder no longer becomes a task. If Mail takes longer than two minutes to answer, j4k waits an hour before it asks again.

entries.title: A mail conversation dragged in becomes one task
entries.detail: Drag a whole conversation from Apple Mail onto j4k and it becomes one task, made from its latest mail: that mail's subject, sender and link. Mails of different conversations, dragged together, still become one task each.

entries.title: Dragging a mail conversation no longer crashes the Mac app
entries.detail: A conversation dragged from Apple Mail onto j4k crashed the app. It no longer does. A calendar event dragged in from Calendar had the same fault and is fixed too.

entries.title: No What's New bar; the message bar is amber
entries.detail: The What's New bar above the task list is gone. What's new is in Settings › About j4k, which still counts what you have not read. The bar that says what you just did, or what another device changed, is now amber instead of green.

entries.title: The search field sits exactly where folia's does
entries.detail: The search field is now in the exact centre of the top bar, as in folia, and its magnifier is folia's plain icon, with no yellow behind it. In Ask Claude mode the sparkle turns gold.

entries.title: The search field is in the top bar, as in folia
entries.detail: The search field moved from above the task list into the centre of the top bar, and looks like folia's. On a phone it fills the top bar's second row. In Ask Claude mode the field no longer has a microphone or a conversation button; Settings › Brain still opens the conversation.

entries.title: Docs in Settings opens the manual in a window
entries.detail: In the j4k Mac app, Settings › About j4k › Docs opens the j4k Field Manual in a window of the app, as the Docs button in the About j4k window does. In a browser it still opens the page online.
